summary: Phase 3 (v1.2-PRODUCTION) full end-to-end validation — backend pytest 41/41 GREEN; all critical frontend flows verified via Playwright (no-code chip, voice toggle, WhiteLabelKiller MutationObserver, PhaseIndicator, sealing-overlay, ghost persistence, paywall headers).
critical_code_review_comments: pdf_export.py is 540 lines — consider splitting CSS_TEMPLATE into a separate template file for readability (non-blocking).
laurentia_gateway.py is large (~570 lines) but well structured; if it grows further consider splitting query/instances/resolve into sub-routers.
Two 401 responses on /api/auth/me at every page load — expected for anonymous mode but adds noise to console; consider gating the call behind an existing-session check.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 fully validated. Verified: (1) GET /api/laurentia/resolve null/null without FP, device_id-only with new FP, full instance after a /query liaison; (2) GET /api/export/pdf/quota returns {tier:'free', free_exports_used:0, free_exports_limit:2, free_exports_remaining:2}; (3) POST /api/export/pdf with new FP returns 200 + X-Laurentia-Signature='1' + X-Laurentia-Free-Used='1'; (4) test_pdf_export_increments_counter validates the 1→2→402 flow with X-Laurentia-Paywall='creator' and detail containing 'Creator 🪙'; (5) Creator tier path returns Signature='0' and no signature page in PDF; (6) PDF Free has ≥2 pages with 'Certifié par l'Infrastructure' on last page + QR + 'La parole reste'. FRONTEND: chip-no-code prefills composer with <artifact> prompt; header-voice-toggle toggles data-voice-on attribute and persists 'laurentia_voice'='off|on' in localStorage; WhiteLabelKiller purges injected <a class='emergent-badge' href='emergent.sh'> within 1.5s; PhaseIndicator phases 'connecting' and 'analyzing' observed live during SSE stream (synthesizing/rendering not captured because the test prompt produced a quick clean response with no <json>/<artifact> tags — this is expected behaviour); assistant-export-pdf-button click → sealing-overlay visible during export, hidden within ~1.5s, PDF response 200; after page reload /api/laurentia/resolve returns the previously-linked frek_id (ghost persistence working). header-stop-speaking requires real TTS playback to render — could not be unit-tested in headless (no voice catalogue) but the code path in Header.jsx is gated by state==='speaking' which is unreachable without speech synthesis — manual verification recommended in a real browser session. The two console 401s on /api/auth/me are unrelated to Phase 3 and don't break any flow.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration — every assertion in the feature checklist passed at the backend AND frontend layer.
